questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some pineapples are oranges.

All oranges are bananas.

All bananas are plums.

Conclusions:

I. Some pineapples are plums.

II. All oranges are plums.

III. No pineapple is a banana.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aa2960f27739e3561b71abc5722c6b73f1baba09b3d12c7d6c340b04d454be0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pineapples are plums → Follow (As some pineapples are oranges, all oranges are bananas and all bananas are plums. As whole oranges comes in bananas which whole comes in plums and some part of pineapples is common with oranges, therefore it is true.)

II. All oranges are plums → Follow (As all oranges are bananas and all bananas are plums. As whole oranges comes in bananas which whole comes in plums, therefore it is true.)

III. No pineapple is a banana → Does not follow (As some pineapples are oranges and all oranges are bananas. No direct relation is given between pineapples and bananas.

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Three of the following numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) 16 – 9 – 139

__16 × 9__ - 5 = 139

__144 - 5__ = 139

139 = 139 (LHS = RHS)

Option 2) 25 – 7 – 175

__25 × 7__ - 5 = 175

__175 - 5__ = 175

**170 ≠ 175 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Option 3) 12 – 7 – 79

__12 × 7__ - 5 = 79

__84 - 5__ = 79

79 = 79 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4) 17 – 5 – 80

__17 × 5__ - 5 = 80

__85 - 5__ = 80

80 = 80 (LHS = RHS)

Thus, out of all the options '25 – 7 – 175' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
51 is related to 256 by certain logic. Following the same logic, 53 is related to 266. To which of the following is 55 related,

following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the

numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be

performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 5) + 1 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 51 : 256

⇒ (51 × 5) + 1

⇒ 255 + 1 = 256.

For, 53 : 266

⇒ (53 × 5) + 1

⇒ 265 + 1 = 266.

Similarly, for 55 ∶ ?

⇒ (55 × 5) + 1 

⇒ 275 + 1 = 276.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
